production.note: US model years. First: Cadillac's release 'DETROIT – Cadillac today introduced the 2016 CTS-V' with its '2016 CADILLAC CTS-V PRELIMINARY SPECIFICATIONS'. Last: GM Authority (Jonathan Lopez, 14 October 2019): "Production of the high-performance 2019 Cadillac CTS-V variant ended back in April" (gmauthority-last-cts-v); no opened Cadillac page states the end year.

fuel.note: Inferred from the release's description of the supercharged petrol V8.

transmission.note: 'Hydra-Matic 8L90', a 'paddle-shift eight-speed, electronically controlled' automatic. The only transmission.

powerHp.note: 2016 launch rating. Quote: "640 / 477 @ 6400 (SAE certified)" (hp / kW). Edmunds, Cars.com and KBB list the 2016 car at 640 hp.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: a manufacturer figure from a table headed preliminary, matched by a database. 2016 CTS-V sedan, 8-speed automatic (the only car). Quote: "4145 / 1880" (curb weight lb / kg) in the table headed "2016 CADILLAC CTS-V PRELIMINARY SPECIFICATIONS". Edmunds gives the same: "4,145 lbs." for the 2016 4dr Sedan (edmunds-cts-v-2016-specs, a database). Cars.com ("Base Curb Weight: 4,134 lbs", cars-com-cts-v-2016-specs) and KBB ("4134 pounds", kbb-cts-v-2016-specs) list 11 lb less; see discrepancies. No final Cadillac figure was found.

sources.publisher: Cadillac (General Motors; release and specification table reproduced by Car-Revs-Daily)
sources.title: 2016 Cadillac CTS-V introduction release and 2016 Cadillac CTS-V Preliminary Specifications
Details Emerge On Last Cadillac CTS-V Ever Produced, by Jonathan Lopez (14 October 2019)

discrepancies.reason: Cadillac's preliminary table and Edmunds give 4,145 lb; Cars.com and KBB give 4,134 lb (0.3% less). The databases do not say where their figures come from; 4,134 may be a later revision.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,145 lb, the figure in Cadillac's own (preliminary) table, which Edmunds repeats. The difference is well within the 2% tolerance for provisional figures.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 4,145 lb comes from Cadillac's table headed 'PRELIMINARY SPECIFICATIONS' (reproduced by Car-Revs-Daily) and is repeated by Edmunds (a database); Cars.com and KBB (databases) give 4,134 lb. A final Cadillac specification sheet for 2016 to 2019, or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend spec panel, would replace it. The end year (2019) rests on GM Authority, not a Cadillac page.
reviewNotes: Weight 4,145 lb is from Cadillac's table headed 'PRELIMINARY SPECIFICATIONS' (labelled weightQualifier 'preliminary'); Edmunds agrees, Cars.com and KBB give 4,134 lb. A final Cadillac figure would settle it.
